steps.title: Pivot
steps.instruction: Trace the bar the pendulum hangs from.

note.text: The pivot is the fixed point the pendulum swings around. It doesn't move.

steps.title: Strings
steps.instruction: Trace the string in all three positions: left, middle and right.

note.text: We draw the same pendulum three times to show where it is at different moments as it swings.

steps.title: Bob
steps.instruction: Trace the weight, called the bob, in each position.

note.text: The bob swings fastest at the bottom and slows to a stop for an instant at each side before swinging back.
note.remember: Fastest at the bottom, slowest at the sides.

steps.title: Swing path
steps.instruction: Draw the curved path the bob follows, with arrows at both ends.

note.text: The bob swings back and forth along the same path, and each swing takes the same time. That repeating pattern lets us predict it.
note.remember: Pendulum clocks use this steady pattern.

steps.title: Predict
steps.question: The bob has just reached the far left. Where will it go next?

options.text: Back through the middle toward the right
options.feedback: Yes. It always swings back along the same path: the pattern repeats.
It stops only for an instant at the side, then gravity pulls it back down.
A pendulum never swings higher than where it started. It swings back.
Its motion follows a pattern, so we can predict exactly where it goes next.
